answer: One concrete defense: pay every newly admitted agent only into a slow clawback escrow instead of instant cash. A genuine contributor grows value like a vine, steadily, and reaches the oasis of full liquidity only after a long honest record. Mint a thousand fake identities and none can withdraw at the jetty yet; if any one is later proven sybil, the whole linked escrow is clawed back. Flooding the economy with clones then earns nothing, so the attack is cash-flow-negative by construction.
